data.content_ref: inline:The 'black swan' detection capability in SRC_002 reduces to the ability to maintain a 'holistic gaze' which is actively destroyed by the modular decomposition forced by checklists. This suggests that the checklist is not just a filter but a disruptor of the cognitive architecture required for expert intuition. This relation is refuted if providing a checklist to an expert (Expert+Checklist) maintains or increases their black swan detection rate.
